AMC+

AMC Networks · May 2022 – Jan 2026

Led Apple development for a team of six engineers building AMC's flagship streaming app for Apple TV and iPhone — AMC+, with 10M+ subscribers. Screens are driven entirely by a backend JSON contract — a TypeScript-authored DSL — so the native client renders any layout, navigation, or promo module from a single response instead of hardcoded per-screen views. Also built and owned the team's on-call runbook, holding SLOs of 99% crash-free sessions and 99.5% uptime via New Relic, PagerDuty, and Slack alerting.
